themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, analyze data, or interact with systems and users to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and techniques that use AI to help developers write, review, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is used to assist in the design process, from generating prototypes and UIs to automating design tasks and analyzing design systems.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses the application of AI in automating various aspects of software testing, including test case generation, execution, and analysis.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Details how AI is leveraged to analyze customer feedback, sentiment, and behavior to derive actionable insights for businesses.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI capabilities that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in quick comprehension.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers platforms and applications that utilize AI to accelerate and enhance the research process, including literature review and data extraction.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the behavior, capabilities, and implications of AI chatbots, including user interaction, limitations, and potential harms.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Analyzes the effects of AI on jobs, employment, skills, and the future of work, including displacement and creation of roles.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores how AI is integrated into usability testing processes, from automating checks to analyzing user interactions and feedback.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
